design: INDIVIDUAL 05: a massive older councillor with barrel chest, pale silver-and-black hide, four broad fleshy external jaw lobes, thick silver tendrils in a wide low fan. Heavy indigo woven shawl crossing the chest in two layers, ivory short under-tunic, layered bronze wrist rings and several hanging octagonal experience badges. Presents a small round sealed bronze box with both hands extended slightly forward. Broad feet planted apart, no weapon.
